title: Verifier strength does not buy discovery quality: a pre-registered two-domain test of LLM-based automated research, with post-hoc evidence pointing to proposer-pool composition
title_zh: 验证器强度买不来发现质量：一项预注册的双领域LLM自动化研究检验，事后证据指向提案池构成

paragraphs.en: 预注册研究显示验证器强度无法提升LLM自动化研究发现质量，扩大提案池才是关键。 Automated research pipelines pair an LLM proposer with a verifier on an implicit bet: discovery quality rises with verification strength. Under a pre-registered protocol we test this bet in two real-data domains -- job-shop scheduling and vehicular edge offloading on Beijing T-Drive trajectories -- across 100 matched LLM/random pairs per domain and three verifier tiers. The manipulation binds -- a 429-case mutation battery shows scores rising across tiers -- yet the paired LLM-over-random advantage does not scale with it (A, one-sided p=0.1115; D, p=0.9994), and in D shrinks under the strict tier (margin contrast -0.040, p=0.0013). The two lower gates promote identical candidates in 100/100 and 99/100 pairs, so the strict order is untestable when they coincide. Constructively, LLM proposals carry a real paired advantage over random controls, but a post-hoc union-pool analysis shows the fastest path to better discovery is widening the pool, not tightening the gate: mixing the two pools adds +1.52 holdout-value units in domain A (one-sided Wilcoxon, n=100, p=0.0002) -- evidence that pool composition, not verification strength, is the lever. Criteria, ledgers and scripts are archived on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23308866).
paragraphs.zh: 预注册研究显示，验证器强度无法提升LLM自动化研究发现的质量，扩大提案池才是关键。自动化研究流水线将一个LLM提案者与一个验证器配对，其背后的隐含假设是：发现质量随验证强度而提升。 在预注册协议下，我们在两个真实数据领域——作业车间调度和基于北京T-Drive轨迹的车载边缘卸载——中检验这一假设，每个领域配置100对匹配的LLM/随机对照组合，并设置三个验证器层级。 该操控是有效的——429个案例的变异测试组显示得分随层级递增——然而配对的LLM相对随机的优势并未随之扩大（A：单侧p=0.1115；D：p=0.9994），且在D中，严格层级下该优势反而缩小（边际对比-0.040，p=0.0013）。 两个较低门控在100对中的100对和99对中选出完全相同的候选者，因此当二者一致时，严格层级无法被检验。 从建设性角度看，LLM提案相比随机对照确实具有真实的配对优势，但事后并池分析表明，通向更好发现的最快路径是扩大提案池而非收紧门控：混合两个提案池在领域A中带来+1.52个留出值单位（单侧Wilcoxon，n=100，p=0.0002）——这证明提案池的构成而非验证强度才是关键杠杆。 评判标准、账本与脚本已存档于Zenodo（DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23308866）。
